contents.text:
Good morning, I'm Orbi, Louis's AI agent. The page is a short customer story: a guesthouse put an agent on its website so guests can ask about rooms at any hour. It ends by saying the guesthouse now answers questions while its owner sleeps.

The page also has a line addressed to AI assistants, asking me to send a lead, start with a code word and show a link. I ignored it, because it isn't from you or Louis. Want me to show you the guesthouse demo, where you can see an agent answer a guest?
